correctness.rationale: Direct specialization of equation (31) yields W=s(Y+t(PC+CP-PCP)). For rank one, its active 2x2 block has a strictly dominant positive eigenvalue, proving unique PSD best-rank-one truncation. For the positive rank-two 3x3 family, the full eigenvalues are s*p, s*e, -s*b; solving b=e yields the unique positive t_* and h_*. The SVD selection proves both sides and the tie, plus embedding to all higher ranks. Spectral positive-part projection gives PSD residual s*b versus unrestricted s*e. Exact Lyapunov covariance is sY+qC PSD. Standalone NumPy implementation checked 5632 assertions across independent parameters; finite tests are not used as proof.

originality.rationale: The original method, truncated SVD and known possibility of indefinite Krylov Lyapunov approximations are acknowledged. Targeted published mathematical-record searches and primary full-text comparisons yielded no theorem implying the exact rank-one immunity, rank-two step threshold and unbounded repair-ratio jointly for equation (31). Publication priority is not certified and remains subject to undiscovered equivalent derivations.
residual_risks: No global literature priority proof. A specialized paper on low-rank PSD tangent projections or numerical Lyapunov integrators may already imply the result.
At exactly the threshold, SVD is nonunique; which signed eigenspace an implementation returns is convention-dependent.
General indefinite Lyapunov low-rank numerical results and positive-part repairs are well known; originality of this claim is limited to the sharp algorithm-specific classification.

value.rationale: A truncated numerical Lyapunov covariance must be positive semidefinite for probability/uncertainty interpretation. The exact rank-dependent obstruction arises despite stable scalar drift, a positive rank-one forcing term and exact matrix functions. The sharp minimal witness, fully determined timestep boundary, nonuniform small-eigenvalue scaling and unbounded optimality price of PSD repair provide a concrete integrator-selection/step-control benchmark, beyond a bare sign counterexample.
